title: cardamine hirsuta var. sylvatica
intro: Cardamine hirsuta var. sylvatica, commonly known as woodland bittercress, is a variant of the Cardamine hirsuta plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. Woodland bittercress is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine hirsuta var. sylvatica include expectorant, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
